544:t_1:87.en:
$$テッサ$$
($$カナメ$$... Please let me borrow $$相良$$ for just a little while...)

544:t_2:5.en:
$$レナード$$
「The plan has changed. We're going on to $$ヤムスク１１$$ like this.」

544:t_2:6.en:
$$かなめ$$
「F-for someone who failed to die, you look pretty lively.」

544:t_2:7.en:
$$レナード$$
「Thanks to you. I feel clearer than I did before.」

544:t_2:8.en:
$$かなめ$$
(That scar on his forehead... from when I shot him...)

544:t_2:9.en:
$$レナード$$
「That's right. Shall I give you a greeting for the change in policy?」

544:t_2:10.en:
$$かなめ$$
「Change in policy? What are you going to...」

544:t_2:13.en:
$$レナード$$
「This is the new policy. I'm sick and tired of treating you in a gentlemanly manner.」

544:t_2:14.en:
$$レナード$$
「Besides, there isn't much time. From now on I'll make you listen by force if I have to.」

544:t_2:23.en:
$$宗介$$
($n feels it too... I should be here for the first time, yet this feeling, as if I know this place...)

544:t_2:25.en:
$$宗介$$
「Captain, what exactly is this place...」

544:t_2:26.en:
$$テッサ$$
「...As I told you earlier, this was the site of humanity's first $$時空震動$$ experiment, and at the same time...」

544:t_2:27.en:
$$テッサ$$
「The secret of us... of the 《$$ウィスパード$$》... lies sleeping here.」

544:t_2:29.en:
$$テッサ$$
「I'm sorry, $l. Please wait just a little longer before I talk about this.」

544:t_2:30.en:
$$テッサ$$
「But being a $$ウィスパード$$ is the very reason $$カナメ$$ has been targeted by $$アマルガム$$ and other organizations.」

544:t_2:32.en:
$$テッサ$$
「Yes... I chose you as my bodyguard because you are very deeply connected to the $$ウィスパード$$.」

544:t_2:35.en:
$$宗介$$
「I've heard that name from $$アル$$. I believe the chief developer of the ARX series...」

544:t_2:36.en:
$$テッサ$$
「And you are the only one who can use the ARX system that $$バニ$$ built...」

544:t_2:37.en:
$$テッサ$$
「$$ミラ$$ was rescued by you and went on to assemble $$レーバテイン$$, and you have saved me many times as well. And of course, $$カナメ$$ too.」

544:t_2:38.en:
$$テッサ$$
「Even if I searched the whole world, I doubt I would find anyone with ties to the $$ウィスパード$$ as deep as yours.」

544:t_2:39.en:
$$宗介$$
(Indeed... There is no proof, but if $$ナミ$$ of $$ナムサク$$ is one too, that makes five... Six if $$レナード$$ is counted...)

544:t_2:40.en:
$$宗介$$
(Can I really dismiss this as coincidence...?)

544:t_2:41.en:
$$テッサ$$
「I can't tell whether this is coincidence or a kind of fate. But if there is such a thing as God... an absolute being who exists beyond the reach of human fate...」

544:t_2:42.en:
$$テッサ$$
「then you may be the savior God sent to rescue us.」

544:t_2:44.en:
$$テッサ$$
「Your power makes one feel such mysterious things.」

544:t_2:47.en:
$$テッサ$$
「We will soon be able to see ground zero. Please be careful.」

544:t_2:48.en:
$$テッサ$$
「More than 17 years have passed, so I think the effects are slight, but this place confuses the minds of those who approach.」

544:t_2:51.en:
$$テッサ$$
「Yes. It is probably caused by the special experiment that was carried out here.」

544:t_2:52.en:
$$テッサ$$
「The residents had their minds contaminated, and I imagine something terribly tragic happened at the hands of the deranged residents.」

544:t_2:53.en:
$$宗介$$
「Can a $$時空震動$$ cause even that?」

544:t_2:54.en:
$$テッサ$$
「To be precise, the problem was the system used to cause that $$時空震動$$.」

544:t_2:55.en:
$$テッサ$$
「$$ドミトリー・ヴァロフ$$, a genius of the Academy of Sciences of the $$人革連$$...」

544:t_2:56.en:
$$テッサ$$
「He believed that the spirit world, handed down since ancient times, could be used scientifically.」

544:t_2:57.en:
$$テッサ$$
「That is what is called the 'domain that encompasses everything'... the $$オムニ・スフィア$$.」

544:t_2:59.en:
$$テッサ$$
「It is probably the same thing as the $$集合無意識$$ of $$神根島$$.」

544:t_2:60.en:
$$テッサ$$
「And the fact that it shares its name with the $$スフィア$$s that $l and the others hold suggests a necessity beyond merely meaning a 'domain'.」

544:t_2:61.en:
$$宗介$$
「The $$ＴＡＲＯＳ$$ mounted on the $$トゥアハー・デ・ダナン$$ and $$レーバテイン$$ is, if I remember right...」

544:t_2:62.en:
$$テッサ$$
「Yes... It is short for 'Omnisphere Transposition Reaction'.」

544:t_2:63.en:
$$宗介$$
「Then the $$ラムダ・ドライバ$$ too, could it be...」

544:t_2:64.en:
$$テッサ$$
「That's right. It is a technology that uses the $$オムニ・スフィア$$.」

544:t_2:65.en:
$$テッサ$$
「If I started explaining, it would spread all the way to the origins of the AS, and there is no time to explain right now, but...」

544:t_2:68.en:
$n
「Footsteps are closing in... Captain $$テスタロッサ$$ and the others, please go on ahead.」

544:t_2:69.en:
$$宗介$$
「You intend to hold them off by yourself?」

544:t_2:70.en:
$n
「I have Jeet Kune Do and $$ブーストアップ$$. And if it comes to it, I'll call $$ジェニオン$$.」

544:t_2:71.en:
$$テッサ$$
「All right. I leave this to you.」

544:t_2:73.en:
$n
(Don't worry, $$宗介$$. I don't intend to end in a place like this, either.)

544:t_2:78.en:
$$クロノ隊員$$
「Advance! We'll clear away anyone who gets in the way of our mission!」

544:t_2:82.en:
$n
(What is this lack of resistance... They don't seem like people who have had combat training...)

544:t_2:83.en:
$n
(Could it be that in mobile weapon combat too, they just rely on the performance of their machines...)

ドミトリー・ヴァロフ.evidence: FMP: Human Reform League Academy of Sciences genius, Yamsk-11 experiment; romanization unsure
